annotations.title: Free check of an app or website

description: A free public read of an App Store app (its link or id) or a website (its domain): the app's US listing facts (name, genre, rating), or what the site's home page shows search engines and whether it links to the App Store. Google Play is not supported. The full check (ranks for five searches, what ChatGPT names, a subtitle to try) runs once per account: the owner signs up and runs it from the returned page. One result per product is shared for 24 hours.
